description_id: Aplikasi deteksi gambar untuk membedakan sampah Organik dan Anorganik secara otomatis. Bertujuan membantu digitalisasi pengelolaan sampah rumah tangga dan instansi.
description_en: Image detection application to automatically classify Organic and Inorganic waste, designed to support waste management digitization in households and institutions.
architecture_id: Model dilatih menggunakan arsitektur Convolutional Neural Network EfficientNetV2 (TensorFlow/Keras) berukuran input 224x224. Backend API dibangun menggunakan FastAPI, dikontainerisasi dengan Docker, dan dideploy pada Hugging Face Spaces. Frontend UI dibangun dengan React dan dideploy di Vercel.
architecture_en: Model is trained using the EfficientNetV2 Convolutional Neural Network architecture (TensorFlow/Keras) with a 224x224 input size. Backend API is built using FastAPI, containerized with Docker, and deployed on Hugging Face Spaces. Frontend UI is built using React and hosted on Vercel.

blueprint.function_id: Stream Kamera WebRTC / Unggahan Citra -> Preprocessing & Normalisasi Tensor (224x224 RGB) -> Fine-Tuned EfficientNetV2 CNN Backbone -> FastAPI REST Inference Container (Docker) -> Output Kelas Sampah (Organik/Anorganik) + Skor Keyakinan + Rekomendasi Penanganan.
blueprint.function_en: WebRTC Camera Stream / Image Upload -> Tensor Preprocessing & Normalization (224x224 RGB) -> Fine-Tuned EfficientNetV2 CNN Backbone -> Dockerized FastAPI Inference Container -> Waste Category (Organic/Inorganic) + Confidence Score + Disposal Guide.
blueprint.utility_id: Mengurangi kesalahan pemilahan sampah di sumber rumah tangga dan fasilitas publik tanpa memerlukan perangkat keras sensor mahal, cukup menggunakan kamera smartphone atau webcam standar.
blueprint.utility_en: Reduces waste sorting errors at household and institutional collection points without expensive sensor hardware, operating directly on standard smartphone or webcam cameras.
blueprint.target_id: Bank sampah digital, fasilitas pengelolaan limbah kampus/instansi, dan edukasi pemilahan sampah masyarakat.
blueprint.target_en: Digital waste banks, campus/institutional recycling facilities, and public waste management programs.
layman_proof_id: Uji Kamera Langsung (Live Camera): Arahkan kamera HP/laptop ke benda di sekitar (misal botol plastik atau sisa daun), sistem langsung menampilkan label Organik/Anorganik dalam hitungan milidetik.
Indikator Persentase Keyakinan: Menampilkan angka probabilitas yang jelas (misal: 98.4% Anorganik) sehingga pengguna tahu seberapa yakin model terhadap gambar tersebut.
Pemisahan Arsitektur Backend & UI: Antarmuka web di Vercel berkomunikasi langsung dengan container API produksi di Hugging Face Spaces.
layman_proof_en: Instant Live Camera Test: Point any phone or laptop webcam at a plastic bottle or organic item and see the classification badge appear in real time.
Confidence Percentage Meter: Displays transparent probability scores (e.g., 98.4% Inorganic) alongside practical disposal instructions.
Decoupled Cloud Deployment: Responsive React frontend on Vercel communicating with a containerized FastAPI inference engine on Hugging Face Spaces.

eval_metrics.secondary: Superior generalization on varied lighting & backgrounds
Stateless REST endpoint with CORS & Pillow validation
